bullets.text: Chelsea Stadium Gets Mobile Boost - **Virgin Media O2** enhances connectivity for fans at Stamford Bridge with upgraded mobile infrastructure.
AI Optimizes Telco Energy Use - AI could significantly reduce energy consumption in telecom networks, addressing sustainability challenges.
Ericsson Cuts Jobs in Sweden - **Ericsson** plans to lay off 1,600 employees as part of a global cost-cutting initiative.
Longer Spectrum Rights Proposed - EU drafts may extend telecom operators' access to radio spectrum, stabilizing network planning.
NTT DATA Launches Marine Cable - A new $1 billion submarine cable will enhance connectivity across Asia, led by **NTT DATA**.
AI-RAN Delivers ROI for Telcos - AI-driven radio access networks are proving effective in enhancing energy efficiency and operational costs.
Brady Enhances Labelling Solutions - **Brady** updates mobile labelling printers to improve telecom network maintenance efficiency.
FirstNet Expands with Satellite - **AT&T's** FirstNet plans to integrate satellite connectivity to enhance emergency response coverage.
